title: Auto model routing
subtitle: Visually configure the classifier, task categories, and category × difficulty routing matrix, then test the full pipeline before saving.

presets.menuTitle: Auto-fill policy from active chat models

balanced.title: Balanced tiers (Recommended)
balanced.description: Fast models handle casual turns; flagship models handle hard coding, math, and analysis.

costSaver.title: Cost optimized
costSaver.description: Prefer lightweight models by default and escalate only on hard reasoning tasks.

codingPro.title: Coding & reasoning first
codingPro.description: Prioritize strongest models for coding and math with a wider history window.

alerts.unavailableModelsDescription: These models are disabled or not active chat models and will be skipped at runtime: {models}
alerts.noRulesDescription: With zero rules, the LLM classifier is skipped automatically to save latency and cost, falling back through sticky → defaultModels → first active model.

classifier.title: Classifier & runtime
classifier.description: Configure the fast model used for request classification, timeout fallback, and conversation history window.
classifier.modelSelectedHint: Uses {model} to classify each turn; usage is billed as the model_router basic service.
classifier.followingTaskModelHint: Currently following the Conversation Task Model setting: {model}.
classifier.modelFallbackHint: When unset, automatically reuses the previous turn model or the default chat route.
classifier.timeoutHint: Aborts classification after this limit and falls back smoothly to the sticky or default model.
classifier.historyHint: Passed to the classifier to judge topic shifts (switch); set to 0 to inspect only the latest turn.

defaultModels.title: Default fallback chain
defaultModels.description: Tried in order from top to bottom whenever no rule matches or rule models fail hard constraints.
defaultModels.empty: When empty, automatically falls back to the first active chat model in catalog order.
defaultModels.orderDescription: Hard constraints → sticky model (when switch=false) → exact difficulty rule → any-difficulty rule → default fallback chain → first active model.

chain.unavailableHint: This model is disabled, lacks an active source, or is not a chat model and will be skipped.

matrix.title: Routing rules matrix
matrix.description: Click any category × difficulty cell to edit its prioritized model chain. Unset cells inherit the category's any-difficulty rule or fall back to defaults.
matrix.popoverAnyHint: Used when no exact difficulty rule matches for this category.
matrix.popoverExactHint: Matched first for this exact difficulty. Clear to inherit the any-difficulty rule.
matrix.cellEmpty: No explicit models configured for this cell. Add candidates below.
matrix.priorityOrderHint: Selects the first available model that satisfies hard constraints
matrix.emptyRulesDescription: Switch to matrix view and click any cell, or add your first category-to-model rule below.
matrix.priorityNote: Exact difficulty rules always take precedence over any-difficulty rules

categories.title: Task categories
categories.description: The classifier assigns each incoming user message to one of these categories. Clear descriptions improve routing accuracy.
categories.emptyDescription: No description set; classifier relies on the key name only.
categories.dialogDescription: Renaming a category key automatically updates all routing rules referencing it.
categories.keyHint: 1–32 chars of a-z, 0-9, _ or -, e.g. coding, sql, agent.
categories.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe what kind of user requests belong to this category...
categories.descriptionHint: Up to 300 characters, injected into the classifier system prompt.
categories.deleteConfirmDescription: The classifier will no longer output this category.
categories.deleteConfirmWithRules: {count} routing rule(s) reference this category and will also be removed.

validation.keyPattern: Use 1–32 chars of lowercase a-z, 0-9, _ or -
validation.keyDuplicate: A category with this key already exists

candidatesPanel.title: Candidate model capabilities
candidatesPanel.description: Reference of active chat models and their routing capabilities (undeclared vision/tools are allowed through).

simulator.modeLiveDescription: Calls the real classifier with your draft policy (without conversation billing) to inspect latency and output.
simulator.modeDryRunDescription: Instant client-side simulation: toggle hard constraints and assumed classifications with zero latency.

greeting.label: Simple chat
greeting.prompt: Hi, explain what HTTPS is in one short sentence.

algorithm.label: Hard coding
algorithm.prompt: Implement a lock-free ring buffer in Go and explain memory ordering and ABA mitigation.

visionChart.label: Image analysis
visionChart.prompt: Analyze the bottlenecks shown in this architecture diagram and propose a split plan.

webTool.label: Web + tools
webTool.prompt: Search today's latest tech headlines and call tools to produce a 3-bullet briefing.

longContext.label: Long context
longContext.prompt: Based on the 100k-word earnings filing above, summarize core risk factors chapter by chapter.

simulator.messagePlaceholder: Enter a sample user prompt to see how the classifier routes it...
simulator.previousModelHint: Set to test multi-turn stickiness when switch=false or fallback when classification fails.
simulator.emptyDescription: Click "Run live classification test" to invoke the real classifier, or switch to "Instant dry-run" to preview rules immediately.
simulator.relaxedDescription: To avoid hard-failing Auto mode, all candidates are retained so downstream can surface a clear capability error.
simulator.stickyExplanation: Previous model {model} passed constraints and no switch was requested, keeping session stickiness.
simulator.noMatchedRuleExplanation: No explicit rule matched (or classification was skipped/failed); selecting from defaults or catalog.

skipped.dry_run: Running in instant dry-run mode without invoking a live LLM.
skipped.single_candidate: Only 1 candidate survived filtering; classification short-circuited.
skipped.no_rules: Policy has no routing rules; classifier call skipped to save latency and cost.

json.title: Policy JSON source
json.description: Synced bidirectionally with the visual studio for quick copy, paste, or bulk editing.

toast.signInAgain: Please sign in again to continue.
toast.loadFailed: Failed to load model router settings
